payload.title: Authenticate exact-name function disclosure projection before materializing retained source
payload.summary: Priority1 supported Context correctness at a public value boundary. materialize_python_function_disclosure_source validates occurrence snapshot and bounds but not its association with selected_match.knowledge.support or the source dependency. Independent real-observation two-file fixture: a.py contains def wanted(): return "A" and b.py contains equal-length def decoy_(): return "B". Replacing only disclosure.items[0].source_occurrence.resource_address with b.py preserves selected match a.py and disclosure.identity, yet materializes b.py successfully. Existing redirected-resource test rejects only because its alternative resource has too few lines. Deliberately inconsistent same-ID snapshot content also passes. This is not demonstrated native Qwen edit authority bypass: native ContextTools uses SourceSearchDisclosureOption and map Planning instead.
payload.benefit: Bounded repair in existing function Context owners, no new identity/parser: verify ordered selected/item membership and exact occurrence/projection against native knowledge; verify repository/resource dependency and retained resource/content association before returning a successful materialization. Preserve original raw-range error contracts or explicitly qualify migration, zero-selection behavior, all-match ordering, Unicode/CRLF/CR/no-final-newline extraction and no reacquisition/reparse guarantee. Independently test valid-range redirect, modified projection/name/kind, same-ID changed content, foreign repository, duplicate/dropped items and genuine unchanged retained snapshots after disk edits; compose rendering/model request and verify absence of decoy source. Keep malformed-coordinate unit tests distinct from knowledge-authentication tests. Run focused/static and exact-tree protected 100% branch gate. Suitable focused maintenance implementation; do not rewrite historical experiment source.
payload.uncertainty: Requires a compatibility review of directly constructed disclosure values and zero-result semantics. Original factory-generated flows pass188 selected tests. No historical corruption, source-authority breach or model exploit established. This checkpoint records an independently qualified pending repair, not an implemented fix.
